title.en: Intensive reading: Effects of Islamic culture
title.ur: Gehri qiraat: Islami saqafat ke asaar

intro.en: This reading shows how Muslims enriched human thought and science: tafsir, fiqh, astronomy, mathematics, optics, medicine and geography. Read it slowly, then do the comprehension drills.
intro.ur: Is qiraat mein hum dekhenge ke Musalmanon ne insani fikr aur uloom ko kaise aage barhaya: tafseer, fiqh, falak, riyaziyat, optics, tibb aur jughrafiya. Aahista parhein, phir sawalat hal karein.
intro.ar: يُبَيِّنُ هذا النَّصُّ كَيْفَ أَغْنى المُسْلِمونَ الفِكْرَ وَالعِلْمَ الإِنْسانِيَّ: في التَّفْسيرِ وَالفِقْهِ وَالفَلَكِ وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ وَالبَصَرِيّاتِ وَالطِّبِّ وَالجُغْرافْيا. اقْرَأْهُ بِبُطْءٍ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الفَهْمِ.

dialogue.ar: كانَ مِنْ آثارِ الثَّقافَةِ الإسْلامِيَّةِ الأَصيلَةِ، أَنَّها قَدَّمَتْ لِلفِكْرِ الإِنْسانِيِّ جَديداً في كُلِّ جانِبٍ مِنْ جَوانِبِ نَشاطِهِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna min āthāri th-thaqāfati l-islāmiyyati l-aṣīla, annahā qaddamat lil-fikri l-insāniyyi jadīdan fī kulli jānib
dialogue.en: One effect of authentic Islamic culture is that it offered human thought something new in every area of its activity.
dialogue.ur: Asil Islami saqafat ka aik asar yeh tha ke usne insani fikr ko har pehlu mein kuch naya diya.

dialogue.ar: تَعْتَمِدُ هذِهِ الثَّقافَةُ الأَصيلَةُ عَلى الكِتابِ وَالسُّنَّةِ، وَعَلى نَظْرَةِ الإِسْلامِ إلى الإِنْسانِ وَتَكْريمِهِ.
dialogue.tr: taʿtamidu hādhihi th-thaqāfatu l-aṣīlatu ʿalā l-kitābi was-sunna, waʿalā naẓrati l-islāmi ilā l-insāni wa-takrīmih
dialogue.en: This culture relies on the Book and the Sunnah, and on Islam's view of the human being and honouring him.
dialogue.ur: Yeh saqafat Quran o Sunnat par aur insan ke baare mein Islam ki nazar aur uski izzat par qaim hai.

dialogue.ar: وَظَلَّتِ اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةَ العُلومِ وَالآدابِ، وَالتَّقَدُّمِ الفِكْرِيِّ عِدَّةَ قُرونٍ فِي جَميعِ أَنْحاءِ العالَمِ المُتَمَدِّنِ آنَذاكَ.
dialogue.tr: wa-ẓallati l-lughatu l-ʿarabiyyatu lughata l-ʿulūmi wal-ādāb, wat-taqaddumi l-fikriyyi ʿiddata qurūn
dialogue.en: Arabic remained the language of sciences, literature and intellectual progress for several centuries across the civilized world of that time.
dialogue.ur: Arabi kai sadiyon tak uloom, adab aur fikri taraqqi ki zubaan rahi.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ نَشَأَتِ الحاجَةُ عِنْدَ المُسْلِمينَ إلى التَّعَرُّفِ إلى القُرْآنِ، وَسيرَةِ الرَّسولِ ﷺ، فَظَهَرَتْ عُلومُ التَّفْسيرِ وَالسِّيرَةِ وَعِلْمُ الرِّجالِ.
dialogue.tr: laqad nasha'at l-ḥājatu ʿinda l-muslimīna ilā t-taʿarrufi ilā l-qur'ān, wa-sīrati r-rasūl, fa-ẓaharat ʿulūmu t-tafsīri was-sīra
dialogue.en: Muslims felt the need to know the Quran and the Prophet's biography, so the sciences of tafsir and seerah appeared.
dialogue.ur: Musalmanon ko Quran aur Rasool ﷺ ki seerat jaanne ki zaroorat hui, to tafseer aur seerat ke uloom wujood mein aaye.

dialogue.ar: وَنَشَأَتِ الحاجَةُ إلى التَّشْريعِ، فَظَهَرَتْ عُلومُ الفِقْهِ وَالأُصولِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-nasha'at l-ḥājatu ilā t-tashrīʿ, fa-ẓaharat ʿulūmu l-fiqhi wal-uṣūl
dialogue.en: The need for legislation arose, so the sciences of fiqh and its principles appeared.
dialogue.ur: Qanoon sazi ki zaroorat hui to fiqh aur usool ke uloom zahir hue.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ الفَلَكُ وَالرِّياضِيّاتُ أَوَّلَ العُلومِ التي لَفَتَتْ أَنْظارَ العُلَماءِ المُسْلِمينَ.
dialogue.tr: wa-kāna l-falaku war-riyāḍiyyātu awwala l-ʿulūmi llatī lafatat anẓāra l-ʿulamā'i l-muslimīn
dialogue.en: Astronomy and mathematics were the first sciences to attract Muslim scholars.
dialogue.ur: Falak aur riyaziyat sab se pehle uloom the jinhon ne Muslim ulama ki tawajjoh khenchi.

dialogue.ar: وَيُعَدُّ كِتابُ البَصَرِيّاتِ لِابْنِ الهَيْثَمِ مِنْ أَهَمِّ مُنْجَزاتِ العُلَماءِ المُسْلِمينَ في عِلْمِ الضَّوْءِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-yuʿaddu kitābu l-baṣariyyāt li-bni l-haytham min ahammi munjazāt il-ʿulamā'i l-muslimīn fī ʿilmi ḍ-ḍaw'
dialogue.en: Ibn al-Haytham's Book of Optics counts among the most important achievements of Muslim scholars in the science of light.
dialogue.ur: Ibn al-Haytham ki kitab al-Basariyyat roshni ke ilm mein Muslim ulama ke ahem karnamon mein shumar hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ ابْنُ سينا أَعْظَمَ طَبيبٍ عَرَفَهُ العالَمُ في زَمَنِهِ، وَاسْتُعْمِلَ كِتابُهُ القانونُ في الطِّبِّ في الجامِعاتِ الإيطالِيَّةِ وَالفَرَنْسِيَّةِ طيلَةَ سِتَّةِ قُرونٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa-kāna bnu sīnā aʿẓama ṭabībin ʿarafahu l-ʿālamu fī zamanih, wa-stuʿmila kitābuhu l-qānūnu fiṭ-ṭibb fil-jāmiʿāti l-iṭāliyyati wal-faransiyya ṭīlata sittati qurūn
dialogue.en: Ibn Sina was the greatest physician the world knew in his time, and his book Al-Qanun in medicine was used in Italian and French universities for six centuries.
dialogue.ur: Ibn Sina apne zamane ka sab se bara tabeeb tha, aur uski kitab al-Qanun chhe sadiyon tak Italvi aur Faransisi jamiaat mein parhai gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَفي مَيْدانِ الدِّراساتِ الجُغْرافِيَّةِ، صَنَعَ الإِدْريسِيُّ كُرَةً سَماوِيَّةً وَخَريطَةً لِلعالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-fī maydāni d-dirāsāti l-jughrāfiyya, ṣanaʿa l-idrīsiyyu kuratan samāwiyyatan wa-kharīṭatan lil-ʿālam
dialogue.en: In geography, Al-Idrisi made a celestial globe and a map of the world.
dialogue.ur: Jughrafiya ke maidan mein Idrisi ne aasmani globe aur dunya ka naqsha banaya.

q.en: Which sources does authentic Islamic culture rely on, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq asil Islami saqafat kin par qaim hai?
q.ar: عَلى أَيِّ مَصادِرَ تَعْتَمِدُ الثَّقافَةُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ الأَصيلَةُ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Which two sciences first attracted Muslim scholars?
q.ur: Muslim ulama ki tawajjoh sab se pehle kin do uloom ne khenchi?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِلْمَيْنِ جَذَبا العُلَماءَ المُسْلِمينَ أَوَّلاً؟

q.en: What is Ibn al-Haytham famous for?
q.ur: Ibn al-Haytham kis ilm mein mashhoor hai?

q.en: Whose book Al-Qanun was used in European universities?
q.ur: Kiski kitab al-Qanun Europe ki jamiaat mein parhai gayi?
q.ar: صاحِبُ كِتابِ «القانونِ» الَّذي دُرِّسَ في الجامِعاتِ الأُورُبِّيَّةِ هُوَ:

intro.en: Arabic has many kinds of plural. Sound masculine plural adds ـونَ/ـينَ (مُسْلِمونَ). Sound feminine plural adds ـات (مُسْلِماتٌ). A broken plural changes the shape of the word (كِتاب → كُتُب). Also learn collective nouns like عَرَب and أَسَد.
intro.ur: Arabi mein jam' ki kai qismen hain. Jam' muzakkar salim mein ـونَ/ـينَ lagta hai (مُسْلِمونَ). Jam' muannas salim mein ـات (مُسْلِماتٌ). Jam' taksir mein lafz ki shakal badal jati hai (كِتاب → كُتُب). Ism-e-jins aur ism-e-jam' bhi seekhein.
intro.ar: لِلْجَمْعِ في العَرَبِيَّةِ أَنْواعٌ كَثيرَةٌ. جَمْعُ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمُ يَزيدُ ـونَ أَوْ ـينَ (مُسْلِمونَ)، وَجَمْعُ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمُ يَزيدُ ـات (مُسْلِماتٌ)، وَجَمْعُ التَّكْسيرِ يَتَغَيَّرُ فيهِ شَكْلُ الكَلِمَةِ (كِتابٌ ← كُتُبٌ). وَتَتَعَلَّمُ أَيْضاً اسْمَ الجَمْعِ وَاسْمَ الجِنْسِ مِثْلَ عَرَب وَأَسَد.

q.en: Which is a sound masculine plural?
q.ur: Inmein se jam' muzakkar salim kaun sa hai?

q.en: Which is a sound feminine plural?
q.ur: Jam' muannas salim kaun sa hai?
Jam' taksir mein kya hota hai?

options: changes the form of the singular

intro.en: Two listening texts about Muslim minorities: first in Europe and North America, then in South America and Australia. After listening, answer true/false statements about what you heard.
intro.ur: Do sunne ke matn hain: pehla Europe aur Shimali Amrika ki Muslim aqliyyaton ke baare mein, doosra Junubi Amrika aur Australia ke baare mein. Sunne ke baad sahih/ghalat jawab dein.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ عَنِ الأَقَلِّيّاتِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ: الأَوَّلُ في أُورُبّا وَأَمْريكا الشَّمالِيَّةِ، وَالثّاني في أَمْريكا الجَنوبِيَّةِ وَأُسْتْرالْيا. بَعْدَ الِاسْتِماعِ تَحْكُمُ عَلى جُمَلٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ.

options_ar: جَماعاتٌ قَليلَةُ العَدَدِ بَيْنَ سُكّانِ بَلَدٍ

q.ur: Australia ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ هذِهِ الأَسْماءِ تَعيشُ حَيَواناتُ الكَنْغَرِ؟

options_ar: الَّذينَ يَنْتَقِلونَ مِنْ بَلَدِهِمْ لِيَسْكُنوا في بَلَدٍ آخَرَ

intro.en: In this lesson you choose a topic, prepare a speech and deliver it to your classmates without reading. Plan the main points, evidence and examples first.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein aap koi mauzu chunte hain, taqreer taiyar karte hain aur sathiyon ke samne bina parhe sunate hain. Pehle ahem nukte, dalail aur misalein likh len.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ تَخْتارُ مَوْضوعاً وَتُحَضِّرُ خُطْبَةً وَتُلْقيها أَمامَ زُمَلائِكَ دونَ قِراءَةٍ. خَطِّطْ أَوَّلاً لِلْعَناصِرِ الرَّئيسَةِ وَالأَدِلَّةِ وَالأَمْثِلَةِ.

q.en: What do you do in this exercise?
q.ur: Is mashq mein aap kya karte hain?

options: Choose a topic and give a speech
Fill in blanks with derived words

intro.en: Derived nouns are formed from verbs. Example: from جَلَسَ we get جالِس (doer), from ضَرَبَ we get مَضْروب (receiver of the action), and مَكْتَب (place). Learn the eight kinds and what each one means.
intro.ur: Mushtaqqat woh alfaz hain jo fel se bante hain. Misal: جَلَسَ se جالِس (karne wala), ضَرَبَ se مَضْروب (jis par kaam hua), aur مَكْتَب (jagah). Aathon qismein aur unke maani seekhein.
intro.ar: المُشْتَقّاتُ أَسْماءٌ تُؤْخَذُ مِنَ الأَفْعالِ. مِثالُ ذلِكَ: مِنْ جَلَسَ نَأْخُذُ جالِس (الفاعِلُ)، وَمِنْ ضَرَبَ نَأْخُذُ مَضْروب (الَّذي وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ)، وَمَكْتَب (المَكانُ). تَعَلَّمِ الأَنْواعَ الثَّمانِيَةَ وَمَعْنى كُلٍّ مِنْها.

options_ar: صيغَةِ مُبالَغَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى كَثْرَةِ الصَّبْرِ

title.en: Extended reading: The Mad Ones (a life story)
title.ur: Wasee qiraat: Deewane (aik zindagi ki kahani)

intro.en: A moving story from «Stories from Life» by Ali al-Tantawi. A poor vegetable seller sacrifices everything so his only son can study abroad, and the son later forgets him. Read it, then answer the questions.
intro.ur: Ali al-Tantawi ki kitab «Qissas min al-Hayat» se aik dardnak kahani. Aik gareeb sabzi farosh apne iklaute bete ko parhane ke liye sab kuch qurban kar deta hai, aur beta baad mein usay bhool jata hai. Parhein aur sawalat hal karein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ مُؤَثِّرَةٌ مِنْ كِتابِ «قِصَصٌ مِنَ الحَياةِ» لِعَلي الطَّنْطاوِيِّ: بائِعُ خُضْراواتٍ فَقيرٌ يُضَحّي بِكُلِّ ما يَمْلِكُ لِيَدْرُسَ ابْنُهُ الوَحيدُ في الخارِجِ، ثُمَّ يَنْساهُ الِابْنُ. اقْرَأْها ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

dialogue.ar: كُنْتُ في شَبابي رَجُلاً مَسْتوراً، أَغْدو مِنْ بَيْتي عَلى دُكّاني التي أَبيعُ فيها الخُضْراواتِ.
dialogue.tr: kuntu fī shabābī rajulan mastūrā, aghdū min baytī ʿalā dukkānī llatī abīʿu fīhā l-khuḍrāwāt
dialogue.en: In my youth I was a man of modest means; I went from my home to my shop where I sold vegetables.
dialogue.ur: Jawani mein main sada, parda-posh aadmi tha; ghar se apni dukan jata jahan sabziyan bechta.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَنا آنَذاكَ أَوْلادٌ، فَكُنّا نَأْكُلُ هذا الطَّعامَ المُتَواضِعَ، وَنَنامُ حامِدينَ رَبَّنا عَلى نِعَمائِهِ وَفَضْلِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa-lam yakun lanā ānadhāka awlād, fa-kunnā na'kulu hādhā ṭ-ṭaʿāma l-mutawāḍiʿ, wa-nanāmu ḥāmidīna rabbanā ʿalā niʿamā'ih
dialogue.en: We had no children then; we ate this simple food and slept thanking our Lord for His blessings.
dialogue.ur: Un dinon hamare koi bachay nahin the; hum yeh saada khana khate aur apne Rab ki nematon par shukr karte hue sote.

dialogue.ar: فِي يَوْمٍ مِنَ الأَيّامِ، حَلَّتِ الفَرْحَةُ العارِمَةُ بَيْتَنا! لَقَدْ حَمَلَتْ زَوْجَتي.
dialogue.tr: fī yawmin minal-ayyām, ḥallati l-farḥatu l-ʿārima baytanā! laqad ḥamalat zawjatī
dialogue.en: One day great joy came to our home! My wife became pregnant.
dialogue.ur: Aik din hamare ghar mein bari khushi aayi! Meri biwi hamila hui.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَتِ القابِلَةُ: البِشارَةُ! لَقَدْ رُزِقْتَ وَلَداً!
dialogue.tr: fa-qālati l-qābila: al-bishāra! laqad ruziqta waladā
dialogue.en: The midwife said: Good news! You have been given a son!
dialogue.ur: Dai ne kaha: Khushkhabri! Aap ko beta ata hua hai!

dialogue.ar: وَبَلَغَ وَلَدُنا الوَحيدُ سِنَّ المَدْرَسَةِ. فَقالَتْ أُمُّهُ: ماذا نَصْنَعُ بِهِ؟ فَقُلْتُ لَها: آخُذُهُ إلى دُكّاني.
dialogue.tr: wa-balagha waladunā l-waḥīdu sinna l-madrasa. fa-qālat ummuh: mādhā naṣnaʿu bih? faqultu lahā: ākhudhuhu ilā dukkānī
dialogue.en: Our only son reached school age. His mother said: What shall we do with him? I said: I will take him to my shop.
dialogue.ur: Hamara iklauta beta school ki umar ko pohancha. Uski maa boli: Hum isay kya banayein? Maine kaha: Isay apni dukan par le jaunga.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَتْ: أُريدُ أَنْ يَصيرَ ابْني مُوَظَّفاً في الحُكومَةِ.
dialogue.tr: faqālat: urīdu an yaṣīra ibnī muwaẓẓafan fil-ḥukūma
dialogue.en: She said: I want my son to become a government employee.
dialogue.ur: Woh boli: Main chahti hoon ke mera beta sarkari mulazim bane.

dialogue.ar: وَأَصَرَّتِ المَرْأَةُ عَلى رَأْيِها، فَأَدْخَلْتُهُ المَدْرَسَةَ، وَنالَ الشَّهادَةَ الِابْتِدائِيَّةَ.
dialogue.tr: wa-aṣarrati l-mar'atu ʿalā ra'yihā, fa-adkhaltuhu l-madrasa, wa-nāla sh-shahādata l-ibtidā'iyya
dialogue.en: The woman insisted on her view, so I put him in school, and he earned the primary certificate.
dialogue.ur: Biwi apni raye par ada rahi, maine usay school mein dakhil karaya, aur usne ibtidai sanad hasil ki.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ الوَلَدُ: أُريدُ أَنْ أُسافِرَ إلى أُوروبّا لِأَدْرُسَ المَرْحَلَةَ الجامِعِيَّةَ هُناكَ!
dialogue.tr: wa-qāl al-walad: urīdu an usāfira ilā ūrūbbā li-adrusa l-marḥalata l-jāmiʿiyya hunāk
dialogue.en: The boy said: I want to travel to Europe to study at university there!
dialogue.ur: Bete ne kaha: Main Europe jana chahta hoon taake wahan university ki parhai karoon!

dialogue.ar: فَبِعْتُ دارِيَ التي أَسْكُنُها لِأَجْلِ وَلَدِيَ الحَبيبِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-biʿtu dāriya llatī askunuhā li-ajli waladiya l-ḥabīb
dialogue.en: So I sold the house I lived in for the sake of my beloved son.
dialogue.ur: Maine apna ghar, jis mein rehta tha, apne pyare bete ke liye bech diya.

dialogue.ar: وَمَرَّ عَلى سَفَرِهِ سَبْعُ سِنينَ كامِلَةً لَمْ نَرَ فيها وَجْهَهُ قَطُّ.
dialogue.tr: wa-marra ʿalā safarihi sabʿu sinīna kāmila lam nara fīhā wajhahu qaṭṭ
dialogue.en: Seven full years passed since he travelled in which we never saw his face.
dialogue.ur: Uske safar ko poore saat saal guzar gaye jin mein humne uska chehra kabhi nahin dekha.

dialogue.ar: فَحَكَموا عَلَيَّ بِأَنْ أُعْطِيَهُمْ ما يُريدونَ، وَإِلّا فَالحَبْسُ يَنْتَظِرُني.
dialogue.tr: fa-ḥakamū ʿalayya bi-an uʿṭiyahum mā yurīdūn, wa-illā fal-ḥabsu yantaẓiruni
dialogue.en: The court ruled that I must give them what they wanted, or else prison was waiting for me.
dialogue.ur: Adalat ne faisla kiya ke jo woh chahte hain main unhein doon, warna qaid meri muntazir hai.

vocab.en: a modest man of limited means

q.en: What did the mother want her son to become?
q.ur: Maa apne bete ko kya banana chahti thi?
q.ar: ماذا أَرادَتِ الأُمُّ أَنْ يَصيرَ ابْنُها؟

q.en: Where did the son want to study at university?
q.ur: Beta university ki parhai kahan karna chahta tha?
q.ar: أَيْنَ أَرادَ الِابْنُ أَنْ يَدْرُسَ في الجامِعَةِ؟

q.en: Why did the father sell his house?

options: To send money for his son
To move to a bigger house
